episodes.title: The Wow Factor
episodes.summary: The group seeks the help of Bo Monkey and Lil Piggie to keep Sindy Sauernotes from stealing the Queen of Pop crown at the Wow Factor competition.

episodes.title: Trophy Trouble
episodes.summary: When a wacky thief disguises himself as a mascot in order to steal trophies all over town, the Spies disguise Shout as a trophy so they can save the day.

episodes.title: Mummy Mayhem
episodes.summary: The Spies must keep an ancient Egyptian crown from getting into the hands of a greedy treasure hunter.

episodes.title: Rocket Ship Alien
episodes.summary: The Spies discover that mysterious mayhem at the local amusement park is being caused by an alien who just wants to fix his spaceship.

episodes.title: Fruit Racer Game
episodes.summary: When Kiki gets zapped into a video game at the arcade, the rest of the Spies must go into the game to save her.

episodes.title: Singing Pirate
episodes.summary: Cap'n Arrrgh steals a famous emerald, leading the Spies on a chase that culminates on the shores of Cap'n Arrrgh's treasure island.

episodes.title: Werewolf Hairwolf
episodes.summary: When werewolves begin to run wild in the streets, the Fresh Beat Band of Spies must figure out who is responsible.

episodes.title: Masked Wrestler
episodes.summary: When a mysterious challenger unmasks all the wrestlers in town, the Spies must wear masks of their own to reveal the cheating challenger.

episodes.title: Cute Crook
episodes.summary: The Fresh Beat Band of Spies must find and stop Squee Z. Dumpkins, a cute crook who wants all the cutest animals in town so that she can stay on top of The Cute List, a web show that counts down the cutest memes and viral videos!

episodes.title: Wild Outlaw
episodes.summary: The Spies must saddle up to stop a wild outlaw from stealing buildings before the entire town disappears.

episodes.title: Bo's Birthday Bash
episodes.summary: The Fresh Beat Band of Spies put on their super spy party hats to search for answers when Bo Monkey's surprise party is ruined.

episodes.title: Fake Fresh Beats
episodes.summary: Three of the sneakiest villains around, Von Winnerchamp, Cap'n Arrrgh, and Yi-Haw, team up with a Master of Disguise to frame the Fresh Beat Band of Spies and get rid of them once and for all!

episodes.title: Dance Bots
episodes.summary: Evil robot builder Dakota Koder sabotages the Top Bot tech competition and gets disqualified, and soon the Fresh Beat Band of Spies must save the city from her robot's angry destruction with a robot dance-off!

episodes.title: Band of Pirates
episodes.summary: Cap'n Arrrgh uses half a stolen pirate map to dig holes around the city to find and steal the valuable treasure – unless the Fresh Beat Band of Spies can get to the treasure first!

episodes.title: Frozen Fresh Beats
episodes.summary: Sven Frugengeblugen, a villainous Viking who hates summer, uses his Froozenhorn to freeze everything in the city! The Fresh Beat Band of Spies put on their winter coats to stop Sven and save summer!

episodes.title: Bunnies Go Bananas
episodes.summary: When a bundle of bunnies accidentally turn Bo Monkey's banana plant into a gigantic banana monster, the Fresh Beat Band of Spies must work together to create an antidote solution before it's too late!

episodes.title: Ghost of Rock
episodes.summary: To save a haunted music theater, the Fresh Beat Band of Spies must help Spooky Spooks, a friendly and energetic ghost who just wants to rock!

episodes.title: Christmas 2.0
episodes.summary: The Fresh Beat Band of Spies deck the halls of the North Pole in order to save Christmas from an overeager elf and his automated Santa.

episodes.title: Sneaky Sneakers
episodes.summary: When Shout's special pair of sneakers get stolen by a pair of athletic siblings, the Fresh Beat Band of Spies must work together with Reed to get them back.

episodes.title: Fresh Beat Babies
episodes.summary: The Queen of Cute, Squee Z. Dumpkins returns with her Fuzzibunkins, who start turning the whole town into super cute babies.
